description: A REST-style API names resources with URLs and uses HTTP methods to read or change them. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Read the request and response pairs in a text editor. They show only headers useful to each idea. No server, account or installation is needed for these exercises; /books is an imaginary practice API.
versionNote: Examples use HTTP semantics and JSON. They are worked exchanges, not a live service.
